name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands tall at the edge of the battlement with the sword raised overhead pointing at the sky and her other hand thrust out palm-forward, hair and cape streaming in the updraft, a fierce, triumphant gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A pillar of white-gold fire spirals up the blade into the sky, a ring of flame blooms around her feet, embers and sparks stream upward, heat haze warps the air and the whole citadel glows.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Pyraxis, diving low over the battlement behind her with its wings spread wide and a roar of fire, flame-red and burnished-gold scales, wreathed in heat haze, wings like sheets of molten bronze
components.headwear: a crown of burnished copper flame spires set with {{GEM}} stones
components.back: a long cape of living flame that streams behind her like wings

notes: HOLO edition 'Flame Empress': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
